reference.code: const nums=s=>{if(!s)return null;let o=[];for(const z of s.split(',')){if(!/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(z))return null;let x=Number(z);if(x< -1000||x>1000)return null;o.push(x)}return o};exports.adjacentDifferences=function(s){let a=nums(s);if(!a)return null;return a.slice(1).map((x,i)=>x-a[i]).join(',')}
